title: A Windflower Embroidery
synonyms: I Remember the Love for My Angel
synopsis: Meet Julio, a gay thirty-year-old man and best-selling author. Despite his success in publishing, however, Julio lives a life of solitude, keeping his true identity a secret while harboring feelings of inferiority regarding his sexuality and bland appearance. His world is soon turned upside-down, though, when he encounters a beautiful young man by the name of Angel. Standing up against the world's discriminations and prejudices, the two are soon captivated by each other... Dedicated to all who are seeking romance, this is a story of cinematic human love!! (Source: Renta!)

synopsis: The main character, a young girl named Sherry, is an excellent "gatherer" who collects special herbs and magic stones. She became a gatherer to help her only relative, her younger sister Irene, a saint, but when Irene comes of age and is engaged, she abandons her and tells her to disappear somewhere. Sherry decides to leave her country and heads for the neighboring Rogue Kingdom, where magic is thriving. Along the way, she meets Aslan, a handsome magician from the Rogue Kingdom... This is the Cinderella story of a gathering nerd who turns her life around. (Source: Natalie, translated)

titleRomaji: Shirobuta Kizoku desu ga Zense no Kioku ga Haeta node Hiyoko na Otouto Sodatemasu @COMIC

titleNative: 白豚貴族ですが前世の記憶が生えたのでひよこな弟育てます@COMIC
synopsis: An empire falling to ruin: The Kio Empire. Living in that empire, is an overweight 5-year-old abandoned by his parents, Prince Ageha. Ageha has memories from a previous life of him living as a Japanese man in another world. He then encounters his younger half-brother, Regulus. Ageha had a vision that Regulus will kill him in the future over inheritance, so Ageha sets out to raise him after Regulus's mother passed. Once the sparkling and fluffy-haired Regulus cozied up to Ageha, He turned into a doting older brother before he even realized! Enjoy a fantasy story of young brothers managing their kingdom, sometimes involving the gods, as they reform it step by step to bring a better land to the next generation! (Source: MangaPlaza)
